detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Storms in the land of Sorana work like dungeons out in the open world. Each one is guarded by tornadoes that hunt you and hazards that keep you on your toes, from lightning strikes to toxic clouds and fire spurts. Break the crystal to clear the storm for good, then set out to find the next one. 

  • Hunting Tornadoes - Outrun or glide around tornadoes that hunt you down, hurling trees, boulders and even enemies at you

  • Storm Guardians - Destroy the generators or find other ways to bring down the shield and fight storm-powered enemies protecting the storm's crystal

  • Storm Rewards - Gather resources infused with storm magic, and earn skill points from the storms you clear

  • Roaming Chaos Storms - Seek shelter and protect your base with a magic shield while large chaos storms sweep across the entire map

Build your base piece by piece, or move into an abandoned village house and make it your own. Place a crystal pillar at its heart to shield it from the chaos storms. 

  • Round Building Pieces - Build round walls and floors from your very first camp

  • Craft From Storage - Craft straight from any chest within your crystal pillar's radius

  • Quick-Stack & Free Repairs - Sort your whole inventory into matching chests with one button, and repair your gear for free

  • Free Placement - Switch between basic snapping, advanced snapping and free placement, and overlap pieces however you like

Set out across a procedurally generated world the storms have reshaped, with a new map for every world you create. 

  • 3 Biomes - Travel from the Whispering Vale and the Howling Woods to the Ember Canyons

  • Creatures Enhanced by the Storms - Hunt Galewings that escape on mini tornadoes, Mistwolves immune to harm while in mist form and Thunderhoof deer that blink out of bow range

  • Ocean Travel - Build a boat and sail to distant islands in search of new storms to cleanse from the land

  • Titan Ruins & Dungeons - Delve into dungeons and search ruins where the remains of once-great stone Titans jut from the ground

Defeat bosses to earn crests you can spend to unlock new classes.

  • 3 Boss Fights - Face the Squallreaver, the Earthbreaker and The Guardian

  • 5 Classes - Spend your crests to unlock the Warrior, Ranger, Mage, Forager or Villager. Choose your path.

  • 100+ Skills - Mix and match over 100 skills from every class you unlock, including 20+ active abilities, to create your own build 

Brave Sorana on your own or team up with friends in online or LAN co-op.

  • Personal Loot - Dungeon and ruin chests hold separate loot for every player so you don’t need to steal from your friends

  • Fast Travel - Place portals to get back to base in an instant

  • World Settings - Choose your difficulty and adjust the danger from the storms

  • Shared Quests - Complete quests together and progress as a group

Add community-made content to your world whenever you want something new.

  • New Places to Explore - Bring community-made locations into your world

  • Level Editor - Create your own content with the built-in level editor and share it with others via Steam Workshop

  • New Equipment & Enemies - Add community-made gear and enemies to your world

  • Custom Game Rules - Change how your world plays with community-made rules
